title: Whispering Wisely：面向ASR微调的智能子集选择
summary: 该研究提出一种基于嵌入的子集选择方法，利用Whisper预训练编码器将音频样本映射到固定维度嵌入空间，并用贪心k-center算法挑选多样且具代表性的训练子集，以降低ASR微调成本。在希伯来语和丹麦语上的实验表明，k-center选择在较小样本预算下常优于随机采样，且所选子集覆盖更广的语言内容。
summary_en: This work introduces an embedding-based subset selection approach for ASR fine-tuning, using Whisper's pretrained encoder to map audio samples into a fixed-dimensional space and a greedy k-center algorithm to pick diverse, representative training subsets. Evaluated on Hebrew and Danish, k-center selection often outperforms random sampling, especially at smaller subset sizes, and captures broader lexical diversity.
